description.title: הצהרה לביטוח חובה
description.summary: This table is a declaration form for mandatory car insurance in Israel, specifically for foreign residents. It confirms the driver's legal status and driving license validity.
description.embed_passage: הצהרה זו מהווה חלק בלתי נפרד מהצעת הביטוח שהוגשה לכם היום. החתום מטה מאשר את מעמדו בישראל כתייר, תושב חוזר או עולה חדש, ומצהיר כי ברשותו רישיון נהיגה המאפשר לו לנהוג באופן חוקי בישראל. הצהרה זו מהווה בסיס להנפקת תעודת הביטוח.
notable_values: Declaration type: integral part of insurance proposal

sketch:
DECLARATION
This declaration is an integral part of the insurance proposal I submitted to you today.
I, the undersigned _____________________ hereby confirm that my status in Israel is a Tourist/returning resident/new immigrant, etc. (state your status __________________) and that I hold a driving license that allows me to drive legally in Israel.
I know that the license I hold is valid and suitable for the type of vehicle proposed for Insurance, and it is under my full responsibility, and the insurance certificate was issued to me only based on this declaration
________________               ___________________          __________________
Name
Signature

טבלה: הצהרה לביטוח חובה
This table is a declaration form for mandatory car insurance in Israel, specifically for foreign residents. It confirms the driver's legal status and driving license validity.
ממדים: Individual declarations, Declaration sections (Name, Signature)

DECLARATION
This declaration is an integral part of the insurance proposal I submitted to you today.
I, the undersigned _____________________ hereby confirm that my status in Israel is a Tourist/returning resident/new immigrant, etc. (state your status __________________) and that I hold a driving license that allows me to drive legally in Israel.
I know that the license I hold is valid and suitable for the type of vehicle proposed for Insurance, and it is under my full responsibility, and the insurance certificate was issued to me only based on this declaration
________________               ___________________          __________________
Name
Signature
